values.summary: Approve the test-only design now; after exact #299 terminal and #298/#299 ancestry proof, bind #300, implement one production-backed table-driven integration target, execute the complete failpoint/adversarial matrix and regressions, record exact evidence, and obtain fresh exact-head review.

steps.action: Repair and independently approve the fully authored test-only design without binding.
After typed #299 terminal and #298/#299 ancestry proof, bind #300 and inventory exact production failpoints.
Implement the complete deterministic before/after, adversarial, idempotency, evidence, sentinel, cleanup, and later-commit matrix in the new integration target only.
Run focused and regression proof, record only observed results, and obtain exact-head review.

invariants: Only production APIs and production-generated receipts provide authority
Every declared boundary has deterministic before/after and restart proof
No sleep or scheduler luck provides ordering
Unsafe or ambiguous state and all unrelated evidence are preserved
Scope remains one new integration test target plus issue-local records
risks: Production failpoint registry may be incomplete
Some mount or ownership negatives may require hosted-platform proof
A required hook could imply a separate production defect
stop_conditions: #299 terminal authority is absent or invalid before bind
#298 or #299 is not ancestral to execution base
Required proof needs a production or shared-test edit
Unresolved design or exact-head review finding
replan_triggers: #299 changes production failpoint or receipt contracts
